usage: The word '地圖' is a noun used to refer to a map, a graphical representation of an area.
It can be used to ask for directions or when discussing places and locations.
'地圖' is often combined with verbs like '睇' (to look at) or '用' (to use).
It can also be part of compound words like '地圖集' (map collection) or '電子地圖' (digital map).
'地圖' is a concrete noun, so it usually appears as the object in a sentence.
